public._comment: Anonymous on purpose - a screen on a wall cannot sign in. Routed service by service, NEVER by a /public/ prefix: a catch-all here would make every future service under that prefix anonymous by default. Read-only scoreboard aggregates only.

public-attendance-pickup._comment: Returns only the children currently requested and not yet signed out, as a display name (first name plus last initial) and a timestamp. No ids, no roster, no history. Anonymous at the gRPC service - a wall display has no Auth0 login and no bearer token is attached here - but NOT open: the PickupDisplay policy requires the enrolment cookie a screen gets from /bff/display-login?key=..., which is the only thing standing between this list and anyone who types the URL. See docs/modules/auth/sign-in.md and docs/work/2026-08-pickup-requests-and-activity-log.md.
